# The third website page

The Constitution appears again on a new HTML page. It is a new page-local footnote, but global numbering continues at **5**.^[See [@brasil1988]{.bibentry}]

A second occurrence on this page reuses footnote **5**.^[See [@brasil1988]{.bibentry}]

José Afonso da Silva then receives footnote **6** on this page.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

This demonstrates the global-numbering variant: **reuse remains local to each HTML page, while the visible footnote sequence continues across the website**.
